title: Le Chala Mashq o Alam Gazi Jo Darya Ki Taraf
body:
Le Chala Mashq-o-Alam Gazi Jo Darya Ki Taraf
Dekti Pyasi Sakina Rahi Darya Ki Taraf
Roke kahti thi sakina Na mere Amu aap
Abna bejongi kabhi tumko main darya ki taraf
<<DIVIDER>>
Kahte the haske addo ab vo alamdar kaha
Peet sarko chale shah jo darya ki taraf
Kuze haathou me liya kahte the pyase bache
Pani Laate hai cha cha dekho who darya ki taraf
<<DIVIDER>>
bharke mashqiza chale naher se pyase ghazi
Loutkar aane lagi fouj vo darya ki taraf
tham kar tuthi kamar kahete sarwar mazher
Ali akber mujhe ab le chalo darya ki taraf
